text:
Alice Nguyen: thinking out loud — want to propose a small deploy-bot UX change: add a /deploy-preview command that does a dry-run, creates a release-note draft, and optionally pins a gitsha. low-risk, helps PMs skim release notes before canary.
Ben Ortiz: nice. do you mean dry-run as in `--dry-run` or a separate subcommand?
Alice Nguyen: separate subcommand so it can't be mistaken for a real rollout. `/deploy-preview <service> <gitsha|branch> --window <tz/iso> --notes-template`
Carla Singh: can we make the notes-template optional but auto-populate with changed routes + infra impact? that would save a ton of manual copy.
Dave Mallory: 👀 also add a `--pin-by-gitsha` flag. we've had incidents where tags moved. pin to sha prevents accidental drift.
Erin Park: ops concern: previews must respect change windows. preview shouldn't schedule anything but should surface if target change window is outside allowed times (quiet hours).
deploy-bot: preflight: configuration lint ok, rollout policy verified, kv-cache status ok. (bot msg)
Alice Nguyen: good point @Erin Park — make preview include a simple change-window check and highlight conflicts. e.g., `window_conflict: true` in the preview output.
Ben Ortiz: UX idea: the preview command returns a short markdown blob you can paste into a PR or release ticket. include canary percents and fallback plan.
Carla Singh: for templates let's add a checkbox section for automated rollback triggers and a recommended smoke test command so SREs can run it quickly.
Dave Mallory: pseudo-output example:
```
Release preview: auth-service @ 3a2f1b
Change window: 2026-03-21T02:00-04:00 (conflict)
Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m
Rollback: auto if errors>0.5% in 5m OR manual `deploy rollback 3a2f1b`
Notes: - route change /auth/login
```
Erin Park: also add a `--stagger` arg for regional rollouts and a `--downtime-assert` opt-in to force checks for migrations.
Alice Nguyen: down to implement a minimal prototype: preview output + template autofill + pin flag. question: should release-bot create the PR draft, or just return blob?
Ben Ortiz: preference: return blob and create a one-click 'create release PR' via console later. keeps CLI fast and low-priv.
Carla Singh: agree. but have an optional `--create-pr` guarded by `--org-approve` and an audit log entry.
deploy-bot: note: `--create-pr` requires repo write token and will prompt for 2fa. (bot msg)
Alice Nguyen: on rollback heuristics: propose a simple threshold engine in deploy-bot config: `thresholds: {error_rate: 0.5, latency: +200ms}` and tie to auto-rollback or pause.
Dave Mallory: make thresholds per-service and overridable per-release via preview flags. i.e. `--threshold error_rate=1.0,latency=250`
Erin Park: ops-oncall: please ensure change-window calendar integration shows a red flag if the target window overlaps a scheduled maintenance in the past 72h.
ops-oncall: noted — we can add a quick calendar check endpoint that previews call. will need the change-window format standardized.
Alice Nguyen: next steps: I'll spike a prototype that returns the preview blob and writes a draft template to `/tmp/release_preview_<sha>.md`. will include `--pin-by-gitsha`, `--stagger`, `--create-pr` (opt-in), and change-window check. anyone want to pair on the CLI flags?
Ben Ortiz: I'll take flags parsing and arg validation.
Carla Singh: I'll own the notes template + smoke test checklist.
Dave Mallory: I'll wire the pin-by-gitsha and rollback threshold plumbing into the deploy runner.
Erin Park: I'll do the change-window guard and calendar check integration.
Alice Nguyen: sweet. aim to have a demo in next week's release sync. thanks all :rocket:
release-bot: auto: created task #INFRA-4829 for deploy-preview POC and assigned to Alice Nguyen, Ben Ortiz, Carla Singh, Dave Mallory, Erin Park. (bot msg)
Ben Ortiz: tiny follow-up — please make preview output include a size estimate (tokens / manifest) so cost-sensitive teams can see infra delta before rollout.
Carla Singh: added to template  — `Estimated P95 memory delta: ...`
Alice Nguyen: awesome. closing thread for now; will post the prototype link when ready. :white_check_mark:
